plugin.name: GMCP_to_world
plugin.author: Tyler Spivey, Nodens
plugin.purpose: Send GMCP events to the world
plugin.description: Use QMud native GMCP to publish prompt-delimited message batches to world variables. No GMCP handler plugin is required.

qmud.script:
require "serialize"
local supports = { {"Char", 1}, {"Char.Skills", 1}, {"Char.Items", 1}, {"Comm.Channel", 1}, {"IRE.Rift", 1}, {"IRE.FileStore", 1}, {"Room", 1}, {"IRE.Composer", 1}, {"Redirect", 1}, {"IRE.Display", 3}, {"IRE.Tasks", 1}, {"IRE.Sound", 1}, {"IRE.Misc", 1}, {"IRE.Time", 1}, {"IRE.Target", 1}, }
--- @brief Registers this plugin's modules. local function register_gmcp_modules () if gmcp then for _, module in ipairs (supports) do gmcpRegisterModule (module[1], module[2]) end end end
local gmcpQueue = {} local logFile = io.open("GMCP_log.txt", "w") local logQueue = {} local logLength = logLength or 0 local logMode = false
local function log(what) if not logState or logLength > 100000 then return end
if what == nil then return elseif type(what) ~= "table" then logFile:write(string.format("%f.2: %s\n", tostring(os.clock()), tostring(what))) logLength = logLength + 1 else local what_table = {} for k,v in pairs(what) do table.insert(what_table, string.format([["%s : %s"]], tostring(k), tostring(v))) end logFile:write(string.format("%f.2: {%s}\n", tostring(os.clock()), tostring(table.concat(what_table, ", ")))) logLength = logLength + 1 end end
function toggleLogMode(state) if not LogMode or state == false then logMode = true else logMode = false end
print(string.format("Incoming Log Mode has been set to: %s", tostring(logMode))) return logMode end
--- @brief Sends an unframed message through GMCP. --- @param data Message name and optional JSON text. --- @return GMCP status code. function SendGMCPPacket(data) return gmcpSend(data) end
--- @brief Sends alias text through GMCP without interpolating it into Lua source. --- @param name Alias name. --- @param line Original command line. --- @param wildcards Captured unframed GMCP message. function send_gmcp(name, line, wildcards) if wildcards[1] ~= "debug" and SendGMCPPacket(wildcards[1]) == 0 then Send("") end end
--- @brief Registers required modules. function OnPluginInstall() register_gmcp_modules() end
--- @brief Registers required modules. function OnPluginEnable() register_gmcp_modules() end
--- @brief Clears the previous connection's prompt batch and registers GMCP modules. function OnPluginConnect() gmcpQueue = {} PromptAck() register_gmcp_modules() end
--- @brief Discards unacknowledged messages from the closed connection. function OnPluginDisconnect() gmcpQueue = {} PromptAck() end
--- @brief Registers required modules after GMCP negotiation. --- @param enabled Whether GMCP is negotiated. function OnPluginGmcpStateChanged(enabled) if enabled then register_gmcp_modules() end end
--- @brief Processes the received GMCP event without consulting later live state. --- @param message Received message name. --- @param payload Parsed payload for this event. --- @param state Accumulated value for this event. --- @param raw Original unframed message. function onPluginGmcpMessage(message, payload, state, raw) local args = raw:sub(#message + 1):match("^%s*(.*)$") gmcpQueue[#gmcpQueue + 1] = {message, args} end
function OnPlugin_IAC_GA() local gmcpQueueStr = serialize.save("gmcpQueue", gmcpQueue) log(gmcpQueueStr) --print(gmcpQueueStr) SetVariable("gmcpQueue", gmcpQueueStr) SetVariable("newPrompt", "1") gmcpQueue = {} end
function OnPluginLineReceived(sText) --tprint(cmdQueue) log(sText) end
function PromptAck() SetVariable("newPrompt", "0") SetVariable("gmcpQueue", "") end
function ExecuteNoStack(cmd) local s = GetOption("enable_command_stack") SetOption("enable_command_stack", 0) Execute(cmd) SetOption("enable_command_stack", s) end
--- @brief Closes the plugin's log file. function OnPluginClose() if logFile then logFile:close() logFile = nil end end
